title: cicd-sensor
line: edr for github actions. the job is the attack surface.
description: open-source ebpf runtime security sensor for github actions and gitlab ci/cd. looks at what the runner actually does while secrets are in memory, not at whether the yaml looks clean.
homeDescription: open-source ebpf runtime security sensor for github actions and gitlab ci. artifact signing and pinned shas matured. runtime insight into the runner itself lagged behind.

title: k8sradar
line: what's known about the cluster you actually run, not the one in the docs.
description: cli vulnerability radar for kubernetes platforms and generic software assets. cvss, epss, kev, sarif out, fail-on in ci. modelled on grype, pointed at the stack you typed in, not a generic benchmark.
homeDescription: you put in provider, kubernetes version, add-ons, node os. you get exploitability, kev, and the version that closes it. built for the moment someone from leadership asks if you are exposed to the thing on the news.

title: supabase-audit
line: rls that looks locked until you actually query it.
description: cli that finds over-permissive row level security, exposed tables, and the supabase misconfigs that keep showing up in assessments.

title: house a kopa

title: cloudwatchdog
